_comment: One-sided caps on the governance corpus. A policy file may shrink freely; growing past its cap is refused. Deliberately NOT the two-sided ratchet tests/structure.py applies to code: an 'improved and not yet recorded' refusal on prose would punish deletion, which is the behaviour this corpus most needs. Raising a cap is a deliberate edit to this file, visible in the diff a reviewer reads.
_measured: Caps recorded at the values measured when policy_lint landed. Governance prose had added 6.8 lines for every line deleted, with no governance document ever getting shorter.
_acceptance: fixtures/policy-rot/budgets.md is capped at 1 line on purpose: it is how the budgets check is shown refusing. The rest of that directory is deliberately uncapped, which is the check's other half.
_generated: `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` carries no cap: it is generated from `.claude/rules/` and byte-compared by rules_sync --check, so its size is its source's.
